socialcues.config.title: Social Cues
socialcues.config.option.layer1Enabled.t: The small status icon floating above a player's nameplate.
socialcues.config.option.layer2Enabled.t: The status icon next to the ping bars in the tab list. Works at any distance, and shows less detail.
socialcues.config.option.layer3Enabled.t: Arm and head movement while typing, a slumped pose while idle, and the screen panel a player holds while in a menu.
socialcues.config.option.scale.tooltip: Size of the icon above players, as a percentage of its normal size.
socialcues.config.option.opacity.tooltip: How solid the icon above players is. Icons also fade out on their own as they get further away.
socialcues.config.option.maxDistance.too: Beyond this distance, cues above players are not drawn at all. The player list is unaffected.
socialcues.config.option.showOnSelf.tool: Show your own status the way other players see it. Only visible in third person.
socialcues.config.option.reducedMotion.t: Removes the small looping motion from icons and body language — bobbing, drifting, swaying, tapping. Poses still change (hands lifting to type, a head drooping while idle); only the constant jitter on top of them stops.
socialcues.config.option.textOnly.toolti: Replaces the icon above a player's head with a short label instead (e.g. "Typing..."). The icon in the player list is unaffected — there's no room there for text.
socialcues.config.option.shareNothing.to: Turns off every kind of sharing below at once — nobody sees your typing, menu, idle, or voice status. This only changes what other players see about you; it never changes what you see about them.
socialcues.config.option.shareTyping.too: Lets other players see when you're typing — in chat, a command, a sign, or a book. Turn it off and that status stops being sent.
socialcues.config.option.shareScreens.to: Lets other players see that you have a menu open — inventory, a chest, and the like. Turn it off and that status stops being sent.
socialcues.config.option.shareScreenDeta: Lets other players see which kind of menu you have open, not just that one is open. Requires "Share menu status" above; turn either off and the detail stops being sent.
socialcues.config.option.shareIdle.toolt: Lets other players see when you're AFK, including whether you're asleep. Turn it off and that status stops being sent.
socialcues.config.option.shareVoice.tool: Lets other players see when you're speaking, if the Simple Voice Chat mod is installed. Turn it off and that status stops being sent.
socialcues.config.option.mutedPlayers.to: Cues from these players are hidden for you. Names are not case sensitive. This is local only — they are never told.
